messages:
Maya: quick follow-up from today's infra update: if a region sees sudden spot reclaim, what's the immediate customer-visible behavior? queue, spill, or degrade? cc @Rahul

Rahul (Infra): goal is seamless for customers where possible. fallback sequence we ran in the last test: 1) absorb on remaining local nodes + short queue (<250ms), 2) soft-spill to nearest-region if within latency budget, 3) switch to quantized/smaller model variant, 4) return 503 with Retry-After if none work. will formalize thresholds.

Maya: what's our short-queue cutoff? teams want exact numbers.

Theo (SRE): from tests: queue up to 250ms smooths bursts. p95 queue > 400ms -> trigger spill. saw this pattern in yesterday's canary:

```
2026-03-22T23:05:12Z autoscaler: attempt scale-up
2026-03-22T23:05:13Z spot: reclaim 36% pool
2026-03-22T23:05:14Z queue.p95: 420ms -> spill->eu-west1
```

OpsBot: Canary report: https://redwood.internal/canaries/preempt-2026-03-22 (summary + logs) :eyes:

Priya (Product): product teams asked for a console toggle to opt-out of cross-region spill for residency. also want an estimated latency penalty shown before enabling.

Ezra (Security): opt-out is required for some customers. also need audit logs of spill events (origin region, dest region, timestamp, request ids).

Rahul (Infra): agreed. plan: per-project routing policy flag + audit events. ETA: backend + API next sprint; UI the sprint after.

Theo (SRE): action items: 1) I'll add telemetry keys spill.reason and spill.dest_region, 2) add alert: spill.rate > 0.5% sustained 5m, 3) add 90s cooldown after failed burst attempts (prevent thrashing).

Maya: what's the quality gating for quantized fallback? teams worry about regressions.

Priya (Product): ask teams to submit 3 representative prompt suites (critical flows). we'll run automated diffs and surface a quality delta score. tie into Optimize recommendations.

Rahul (Infra): I'll draft the playbook with numeric thresholds (suggested: spill if region capacity < 12% OR queue.p95 > 400ms; degrade only if spill blocked or cross-region latency > 150ms). Posting draft by Friday.

Maya: thanks. can we get a 1-page oncall runbook snippet?

Theo (SRE): will drop a 1-pager in #eng-oncall with checklist: check region, check spill flag, verify telemetry, run rollback.

OpsBot: Follow-up meeting scheduled: "Preempt & Spill Playbook" Fri 9:00 PT. Invite sent.

Maya: appreciate the fast turnaround. :pray:
